examName: Assistant Library Director/District Library Officer (Gazetted) Maharashtra Library Service, Group-B Higher and Technical Education Department - Syllabus
examNameMr: सहायक ग्रंथालय संचालक / जिल्हा ग्रंथालय अधिकारी (राजपत्रित), महाराष्ट्र ग्रंथालय सेवा, गट-ब, उच्च व तंत्र शिक्षण विभाग

topics: Meaning of classification and book classification, purpose, necessity and advantages of book classification

Various schemes of book classification - Dewey Decimal Classification (D.D.C.), Colon Classification (C.C.), Universal Decimal Classification (U.D.C.) - their origin, form, structure, features, evolution, edition and comparative information
Meaning of book classification call numbers, function, qualities and necessity
Call number (Call No) - concept and utility
Library catalogue objective, types - internal and external catalogue, utility and importance
Library collaboration, library network (Library network) - its form, function and utility
OPAC - its features and utility
Centralized cataloging, pre-publication cataloging and MARC
Concepts of ISBN, ISBD, CIP, ISSN in cataloging
Interrelationship between cataloging and book classification
Book acquisition - various methods of book acquisition, various means of book selection, characteristics and advantages of book collection
Bookbinder
Accession register and its importance
Action to be taken after collection of loss and price
Measures for protection and conservation of books
Annual report of the library and library committee
Book circulation
Various works in newspaper/periodical department
Test of leadership qualities for the library

units.unitTitleMr: ग्रंथालयीन संदर्भ सेवा व संदर्भ साधने
topics: What is reference service, necessity, type - prompt, delayed and referral reference service
Various types of reference books - Dictionaries, Encyclopedias, Biographical, Geographical reference sources and yearbooks

Important reference books - Marathi Vishwakosh, Encyclopedia Britannica, World Almanac, Manorama Yearbook, Statesman's Yearbook, India Reference Annual, Zilla Darshnika, Date Marathi Granth Suchi, Date Marathi Niyatkalike Lekhsuchi, India Who's Who, International Who's Who, Granthalay Paribhasha Kosh, Shasan Vyavahar Kosh, Rajbhasha Parichay, Prashasnik Lekhan, Prashasan Vakyaprayog
Characteristics and uniqueness of reference book and general book
Criteria for evaluation of reference service
Features, role and function of reference librarian
Catalog, index, bibliography and calendar - type, work and importance
History, format and utility of Indian National Bibliography
Importance and necessity of preservation and digitization of rare documents, manuscripts and rare book collections

units.unitTitle: Modernization of Libraries: Application of Information Technology
units.unitTitleMr: ग्रंथालयाचे ఆధుਨੀકીकरण आणि संगणकीकरण व माहिती तंत्रज्ञानाचे उपयोजन
topics: Modernization of library and computerization or concept
Library computerization - pre-preparation, necessity and advantages
Available software for computerization of library services - Libsys (LIBSYS), SOUL (SOUL), Koha (KOHA), Greenstone (GREENSTONE), Evergreen (EVERGREEN)
Digital library and its related resources and service work
Format and scope of various services provided in internet libraries - e-mail, e-book, e-journal, e-newspaper, employment related information, information on educational service facilities
Difficulties and solutions encountered in computerization of libraries
Information concept, necessity, needs and information collection development

Information service distribution - dissemination of Current Awareness Service (CAS), Selective Dissemination of Information (SDI), Documentation service, Indexing service, Abstracting service, Translation service, Photocopying service
Online database services
Referral services
Growing use of internet and future of printed literature and mutual strengths and limitations
Role of information service and librarian

units.unitTitle: Public Library Movement in Maharashtra - History, Function and Present Status
units.unitTitleMr: महाराष्ट्रातील सार्वजनिक ग्रंथालय चळवळ - इतिहास, कार्य व सध्या स्थिती
topics: Review of the progress of library movement in Maharashtra
Fuz committee report
Kolhapur State Public Library Act - 1945 in the pre-independence princely state period
Maharashtra Public Libraries Act - 1967
Maharashtra Public Libraries (Rules for grant-in-aid and building and equipment for recognition) Rules - 1970
Maharashtra Public Libraries Associations (Recognition and Grant-in-Aid) Rules - 1991
Maharashtra Libraries (Grants to Literary Associations and Research Institutions Libraries) Rules - 1984
Directorate of Libraries, Maharashtra State - Pre-history, establishment, functions, development and present status
Maharashtra State Library Union, Divisional and District Library Union progress and work

Various promotional programs and schemes for public libraries in the state - Award distribution scheme for excellent public libraries, workers and employees, Reading Inspiration Day, District Level Library Festival, Chain scheme, Raja Rammohun Roy Library Foundation, Kolkata scheme, Various schemes providing financial assistance through District Planning and Development Committee, Library Week, Book exhibitions, Certificate course syllabus
Problems and challenges facing state general public libraries
History, development and present status of public library movement in India
Dr. S.R. Ranganathan's contribution and five laws of library science told about library science

Work done by the Government of India for the development of public libraries in the pre-independence and post-independence periods - Model Public Libraries Bills, The Press and Registration of Books Act - 1867, Delivery of Books Act - 1954 and subsequent amendments, The Indian Copyright Act - 1957

Committees, commissions, study groups and special programs appointed by the Government of India for the development of public libraries - K.P. Sinha Advisory Committee, D.P. Chattopadhyaya Committee, Raja Rammohun Roy Library Foundation, National Knowledge Commission, National Book Trust, Community Information Centers (CIC) in Northeast India
Provisions and features of public library acts passed by various states in India
International, national and state level organizations and their work related to libraries - I.F.L.A., A.L.A., I.L.A., I.A.S.L.I.C.
Role and importance of public libraries in social education and development

Work done by UNESCO for the promotion and dissemination of public libraries - Manifesto for public libraries, Library charter, CDS/ISIS information management system, UNESCO project Delhi Public Library

importantNotes: Wherever acts/rules/regulations are mentioned in the syllabus, the latest amendments/modifications in such acts/rules/regulations should be taken into consideration.
